    """Color nested concentric bands inside a rectangular 5-frame."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 5]

    c1 = max(c for _, c in cells)

    # The frame itself stays unchanged. Paint alternating 2/5 borders inward.
    top, bottom, left, right = r0 + 1, r1 - 1, c0 + 1, c1 - 1
    depth = 0
    while top <= bottom and left <= right:
        h, w = bottom - top + 1, right - left + 1
        if h <= 3 or w <= 3:

            out[bottom][c] = color
        for r in range(top, bottom + 1):
            out[r][left] = color
